note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and status bar icons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
editor chrome -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: tab action buttons (close, preview, split, more); user-named file tabs, breadcrumbs, and code content are subtracted
status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: remote indicator, problem counts, port status, notification count, language mode, EOL, encoding, indentation, selection, screen reader mode
